ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.2 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the central and lower regions to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity anchor-shaped region extending to the trailing edge. Two high-intensity lateral fields (lobes). The left lobe contains multiple discrete, high-contrast dark curvilinear streaks. The right lobe contains dense, low-intensity mottling near the inner margin and sparse dark speckling throughout the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central midline with an approximate interior pixel angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary exhibiting high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5 to 15 pixels relative to adjacent valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral boundaries transitioning to sharp, upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates localized at the distal tips and along the outer margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily visible on the high-intensity field of the left lobe, including three dominant vertical/diagonal strokes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization by barnacles along the distal margins and tips; significant linear scarring/rake marks on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark 'comma' shaped mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left white field.
